linkedin:
> MySQL and MariaDB listen on TCP port 3306 by default.

The classic X Protocol, used by MySQL Shell and some newer clients, listens on 33060. List databases with `SHOW DATABASES;`, pick one with `USE dbname;`, then list tables with `SHOW TABLES;`. Connect from the shell with `mysql -h host -P 3306 -u user -p`.
